strings.settings.stay_connected.help: For phones without push: calls and messages reach you while PP is in the background. Shows an ongoing notification and uses more battery.

strings.settings.llm.brief_key_auto: Issued automatically when you register in Profile.
strings.settings.llm.preset_help: Preset defaults apply when saved. Leave API key blank to keep the existing key.
strings.settings.integrations.mcp_help: Custom MCP servers (stdio on desktop; URL on mobile).
strings.settings.network.help_network_hint: When on, this computer helps other PP users reach each other. Takes effect after unlock or restart.
strings.settings.network.connection.title: Connection
strings.settings.network.reachability.summary_un: Not checked yet whether others can reach you.
strings.settings.network.reachability.summary_ch: Testing whether others can reach you directly…
strings.settings.network.reachability.summary_re: Others can connect to this device directly.
Reachable over IPv6 — others can connect directly.
strings.settings.network.reachability.summary_ou: You can reach the network, but others reach you through a server.
strings.settings.network.reachability.summary_bl: Could not reach PP's servers — check your firewall or network.
strings.settings.network.help.outbound_only: You are probably behind a home router. Messages and calls still work through a server; to connect directly, open a port for PP on your router and test again.
strings.settings.network.help.blocked: Allow PP in your firewall or try another network. A VPN can also block direct connections.
strings.settings.network.help.reachable: Others can connect to you directly. Thank you for helping the network.
strings.settings.network.help.skip_relay: You can skip this — messages still work through a server.
strings.settings.network.banner_hint: Until others can reach you directly, connections go through a server. See Me → Network.
strings.settings.network.circuit_relay_hint: Let other people reach each other through this computer.
strings.settings.network.media_relay_hint: Forward call audio/video for others (you can't listen in).
strings.settings.network.dht_hint: Help peers find each other on the mesh. Uses extra bandwidth when enabled.
strings.settings.network.prefer_contacts_hint: Prefer your contacts when connecting, and when helping. Turn off to help the wider network too.
strings.settings.network.direct_connections: Who may connect to me directly
strings.settings.network.direct_connections.help: People who connect directly learn this device's network address (IP). Everyone else reaches you through a server; blocked people never connect directly.
strings.settings.network.trusted_relays.help: A relay sees both ends' network addresses. When on, only our servers and your Friendly contacts' devices relay for you; connections may be slower.
strings.settings.network.reachable_without_relay: Keeps this computer reachable by your contacts directly, even when the relay is down. It stays registered with our network servers, which see when it is online.
strings.settings.security.default_hint: You're using the default PIN. Set your own below.
strings.settings.security.not_setup_hint: You'll set a PIN when you first set up your account or start a private chat.
strings.settings.security.group_invites.help: Controls who can invite you to group chats. Separate from direct messages.
strings.settings.security.calls.help: Calls from anyone else never ring, and the caller is not told. Blocked people can never call.
strings.settings.security.tool_permissions.help: When the assistant wants to change contacts, chats, or identity, it asks in chat. Always allow / Never are remembered here.
strings.settings.security.tool_permissions.reset: Clear saved Always allow and Never decisions. The assistant will ask again before changing your data.
strings.settings.security.clear_undelivered.help: Removes old undelivered delivery-queue items from the relay. Does not clear local chat history.
strings.settings.security.clear_undelivered_conf: This deletes undelivered relay inbox items older than 7 days. Local chat history on this device is not deleted.
strings.settings.security.clear_undelivered.not_: Unlock and register before clearing the delivery queue.
strings.settings.security.link_device: Use this account on another device
strings.settings.security.link_device.help: Copy a transfer code below (valid for 15 minutes). On the new device open PP, choose “I already have an account on another device” and paste it. Your contacts follow; earlier messages stay on this device.
strings.settings.security.link_device.send_hint: Both devices share this account. For now send from one device at a time; both can receive.
strings.settings.security.link_device.reset_hint: Already using another account on this device? Reset it under Storage first.
strings.settings.security.link_device.export_con: The transfer code contains your account keys and works for 15 minutes. Anyone who has it can add your account to their device, so don't share it. Paste it on the new device.
strings.settings.security.link_device.not_ready: Unlock first, then move your account.
strings.settings.security.devices.help: Your main device adds and removes devices. A removed device stops working until it is linked again.
strings.settings.security.devices.remove_confirm: That device will stop working until it is linked to your account again from your main device.
strings.settings.security.devices.make_main_conf: That device will add and remove your devices from now on. This device will no longer be able to add or remove devices.
strings.settings.security.devices.not_main: Only your main device can add or remove devices.
strings.settings.security.devices.signed_out: This device was signed out of your account. Link it again from your main device to use it.
strings.settings.security.recovery.help: These 24 words bring your account back on a new device if you lose this one. Anyone who has them can take your account: write them down, keep them private, and never type them anywhere but this app.
strings.settings.security.recovery.shown_hint: It hides by itself in two minutes.
strings.settings.security.recovery.none: This account was created before recovery phrases and has none.
strings.settings.security.recovery.not_ready: Unlock first to see your recovery phrase.
strings.settings.security.recovery.pin_required: Enter your PIN to see your recovery phrase.
strings.settings.security.copy.help: A saved copy keeps your account's contacts and groups, encrypted: only your recovery phrase opens it. With the phrase it brings your account back even when PP's server has lost it. Keep it anywhere — a drive, a cloud folder.
strings.settings.security.copy.save: Save a copy of my account…
strings.settings.security.copy.not_ready: Unlock first to save a copy of your account.
strings.settings.security.crash_reports.label: Send crash reports
strings.settings.security.crash_reports.help: When on, PP sends us a crash report with no chat content to help fix the problem. Off by default.
strings.settings.security.diagnostics.help: Sends recent technical events, statistics and crash records to help us improve PP. No chat content, names, contacts or addresses.
strings.settings.security.diagnostics.confirm_bo: PP will send its recent technical events, statistics and the last crash record to us, only to help improve the system and the experience. They never include chat content, names, contacts or addresses.
strings.settings.security.diagnostics.refused: Something in the diagnostics looked personal, so nothing was sent.
strings.settings.security.diagnostics.quota_limi: Today's sending limit is reached. Please try again tomorrow.
strings.settings.security.diagnostics.in_progres: The previous send is still being processed; check the reference in a minute.
strings.settings.security.diagnostics.too_large: The diagnostics are too large to send.
strings.settings.security.pin_both_required: Current and new PIN are required
strings.settings.security.unlock_to_change: Unlock first to change the PIN.
strings.settings.storage.reset_chats_confirm_mes: Deletes the chats on this device: conversations, their messages and downloaded files. Your account, keys, contacts and settings stay. This cannot be undone.
strings.settings.storage.reset_confirm_message: Deletes chats, contacts and keys on this device. This cannot be undone. Afterwards you can create a new account or bring one from another device.
strings.settings.storage.reset_confirm_check: I understand this cannot be undone
strings.settings.storage.attachment_policy.label: How photos and files download
strings.settings.storage.attachment_policy.help: Photos and files under 4 MB download by themselves; bigger ones download when you tap them. You can also choose all automatic or all manual.
strings.settings.storage.clear_attachments_confi: Deletes the photos and files saved on this device to free space. Chats are not affected; you can download them again later with a tap.
strings.settings.reset_defaults_confirm_message: This restores this section's settings to their defaults.
strings.pin.unlock_message: Enter your PIN to open PP.
strings.pin.create_message: You'll enter it to open PP. It stays on this device only; if you forget it, no one can recover it.
strings.pin.chooser_message: Set a PIN to protect your chats, or continue with the default for now.
strings.pin.identity_fork_message: PP is private chat and calls: only you and the other person can read your messages. Create a new account, or bring the one you use on another device.
strings.pin.identity_link: I already have an account on another device
strings.pin.link_chooser_message: Set a PIN for this device. It can differ from your other device.
strings.pin.link_create_message: Set a PIN; you'll enter it to open PP.
strings.pin.link_paste_message: Paste the transfer code you copied on your other device. It works for 15 minutes.
strings.pin.link_imported: Your account is now on this device
strings.pin.phrase_chooser_message: Set a PIN for this device, then type your recovery phrase.
strings.pin.phrase_paste_message: Type your 24 words in order. Your account, contacts and groups come back; chats start empty.
strings.pin.phrase_saved_copy_unreadable: That file could not be read. Pick the saved copy of your account again.
strings.pin.phrase_restored: Your account is back on this device
strings.pin.error.wrong: That PIN is not right. Try again.
strings.pin.forget_warning: If you forget your PIN it can't be recovered, and your account and chats will be lost. Please remember it.
strings.pin.forgot_explain: A forgotten PIN can't be recovered, and no one can reset it for you. The only way out is to delete the app and start over as a new account; your old chats and contacts won't come back.
strings.onboarding.name_message: Pick a name. The people you chat with will see it, and you can change it any time in Me → Profile.

strings.onboarding.account_message: Your account is ready. Friends can search your name or enter the account ID below to add you.
strings.onboarding.account_hint: The account ID is not a secret; share it with friends. Only your PIN is private.
strings.onboarding.friends_message: Tap Find friends and tell the assistant a friend's name or account ID to find and add them. You can also send your account ID to friends so they can add you.

strings.ai.overview.intro: Here is what I can do right on this device, no connection needed:
strings.ai.overview.people: **Find people**: “search for user Ken”, “look up Ken”
strings.ai.overview.contacts: **Contacts and chats**: “show my contacts”, “open the chat with Ken”, “my chats”
strings.ai.overview.profile: **My profile**: “change my nickname to Bob”, “my account info”
strings.ai.overview.appearance: **Appearance and language**: “dark mode”, “light mode”, “follow the system”, “switch to English”, “切换到中文”
strings.ai.overview.settings: **Settings**: “show my settings”, “show my network settings”, “my network status”
strings.ai.overview.howto: **How-to**: “how do I search for a user”, “how do I change my nickname”
strings.ai.overview.news: Anything else — questions, news, links — I look up online and answer.
strings.ai.overview.permission: Before changing contacts, chats or your profile, I always ask you first.
